required_action: Read the Prism review discussion threads via trac discuss query, reply to each blocking finding thread with trac discuss reply explaining the fix, and revise the test files in tests/integration/ and tests/e2e/ to address the findings. Every revised test must retain its R-1 long-format marker (AC-FRXXXX-YY@v0.4 TRACKS-TRACE). Do not modify product code or interface stubs. After revising, the tests must remain collectable by pytest and fail with a legitimate Red.
